_readme: Italian display names for things whose English name is their identity.
The English key is what src/data, the save files and the code all use; it must
match the data byte for byte. The Italian value is only ever shown on screen.
Read through src/lib/i18n/index.js — never import this file directly.
Every term here must agree with .claude/skills/translate-it/glossary.json.
